binding: This is a build contract. The render must preserve the four evidence states and the schematic-airframe limitation at phone scale.

palette.world: A bright Kenai cloud deck and atmospheric cross-section, moving from electric storm daylight to a warm sunbreak.

roles.cloud: #63D7F2 electric cyan, observed weather and depth
roles.flare: #F26B45 persimmon, reserved for physical AgI flare activity
roles.terrain: #164B3B deep spruce, Alaska land and the ground plane
roles.radar: #7968E8 violet glass, reserved for observed reflectivity only
roles.record: #B9C6CE nickel, solid company-reported records and observed latches
roles.model: #C6F24A chartreuse, reserved for modeled paths and estimates
roles.absence: #DDE5E8 dashed true void, always paired with NOT REPORTED

palette.semantic_law: Observed records are solid nickel or violet. Company interpretation is a separate attributed ClaimChip. Modeled estimates are chartreuse hairlines with no contact shadow. Before the 87-second reveal, the ground state is a neutral solid open bracket labeled GROUND?. Only at the payoff does unreported surface evidence become a dashed void labeled NOT REPORTED. No state may borrow another state's material.
palette.divergence: Recent films centered brass and indoor console instruments. This one stays outdoors, changes altitude, uses an open vertical column instead of a dial, and treats a small aircraft against enormous weather as the dominant silhouette.

light.time_of_day: late afternoon after a broken storm
light.direction: cool lateral cloud light first, radar glow from within the cross-section, warm rim only after the fair countercase
light.depth_approach: three cloud planes, terrain relief, aerial haze and a lifted black floor; model paths remain self-luminous and shadowless
light.the_light_means: Observation has physical presence. Inference can illuminate a possible path but cannot cast the shadow of a measurement.

shape_language.thesis: SOLID HOOPS VERSUS A THREAD THAT NEVER LATCHES.
shape_language.observed: Opaque hoops, square latches and mechanically seated records.
shape_language.interpreted: Paperlike ClaimChips clipped beside observations, explicitly sourced and removable.
shape_language.modeled: Thin continuously resolving chartreuse paths, curved and branchable, with no floor contact.
shape_language.unmeasured: Dashed open geometry with moving phase and a required NOT REPORTED label.
shape_language.not_generic: The contrast is not success versus failure. It is what the campaign recorded, what the radar observed, what the company inferred, and what the surface record did not report.

casting.hero: SeedDrone, a net-new schematic cloud-seeding quadrotor
casting.airframe_rule: SeedDrone has a neutral sensor window, a flare rack, four rotor discs and landing skids. It has no suppressant tank, no lock-eye behavior and no autonomy animation. Never label the drawn silhouette EL-151 or EL-153; the VO and labels describe the company-reported fleet separately.
casting.throughline_object: EvidenceColumn, a vertical three-hoop proof apparatus with no dial and no needle
supporting_from_shelf: Unnamed for every unreported instrument silhouette
Stage3D, Plane, Atmosphere and CameraMoves from lib/stage3d.tsx for the atmospheric descent
casting.human_figures: None. The operation is told through aircraft, records, radar, models and instruments.

motion_language.signature_move: THE DESCENT. The camera follows the chartreuse model thread from observed radar altitude toward the ground, where it branches before an open dashed hoop instead of resolving into a measured drop.
hero_moves: the schematic drone traverses enormous cloud scale, loads flares, releases them and later banks home
solid evidence hoops latch only when a record or observation arrives
ClaimChips mount beside observations without closing a hoop
the model thread continuously re-solves and branches before the surface
the final measuring cup enters only as the next test, not as a failed campaign instrument
motion_language.anti_slideshow: Every scene carries environmental motion, camera drift and one causal action. Data scenes use one dominant field or transformation at a time.

composition.focal_hierarchy: One dominant subject and one short annotation per beat. The central column is the orientation object, not a dashboard.
composition.phone_scale: One radar field plus a large 7 counter; one 9 x 3 equals 27 transformation; one dominant mean; two short verdict labels. Exact required claim strings may wrap but never compete with a second card.
composition.safe_area: All required text and causal objects remain inside the shared 9:16 and derived 1:1 safe box. Atmospheric depth may extend beyond it.
composition.signature_shot: At 87 seconds, the curved radar beam hangs far above dark spruce terrain while the shadowless model thread branches. Dashed void silhouettes for a gauge and tracer phase beneath it, labeled NOT REPORTED. The Evidence Column's final hoop remains open.
composition.negative_space: The vertical gap between the lowest beam and the surface is the film's largest empty space and its core evidence statement.

craft_advance.why: The shelf lacks a construction-time grammar for epistemic state. A wrapper will enforce observed, interpreted, modeled and unmeasured materials so future scenes cannot accidentally give an estimate a shadow or an absence a solid fill.
components: EvidenceState: observed | interpreted | modeled | unmeasured material wrapper
EvidenceColumn: company-record hoop, observed-radar hoop, attributed chip mount, model channel and dashed ground hoop
RadarGroundCutaway: curved beam, terrain, unresolved model layer and absent-or-confirmed ground evidence
SeedDrone: reference-bounded schematic aircraft with flare rack and no autonomy behavior

video-engine/src/lib/evidence_state.tsx.EvidenceState: discriminated union. observed accepts physical children; interpreted requires source, label and sublabel and constructs ClaimChip; modeled requires path data, fidelity, drawn and occupied and constructs Simulated with no arbitrary children; unmeasured requires path data, label and f, constructs Unnamed internally with solid fixed at zero, and exposes neither arbitrary children nor a solid prop
video-engine/src/lib/evidence_state.tsx.EvidenceColumn: props f, record, radar, interpretation, model, ground unknown|unreported|confirmed, compact; the ground position is neutral before reveal and dashed only when unreported
video-engine/src/lib/evidence_state.tsx.RadarGroundCutaway: props f, modelProgress, groundEvidence unknown|unreported|confirmed, comparison; owns its cloud planes, curved beam, terrain relief and surface instrument geometry
video-engine/src/lib/evidence_state.tsx.SeedDrone: props f, x, y, scale, facing, flareLoad, landed; fixed neutral sensor window, flare rack, no tank, no lock and no autonomy state

video-engine/src/EvidenceLook.tsx.EvidenceLook: look-development composition with full-size and 0.28-scale strips for every evidence state and every dense thesis shot
